|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6.2 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-11-So_Be_It_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. When Luke deploys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader’s site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may ▲ Rise, My Friend. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 31). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[So Be It, Jedi (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “Luke deploys” to “Luke dpeloys” (typo as published; the card list writes the ▲ icon out): “Deploy on table. When Luke dpeloys using your Objective, he deploys to Vader's site (if possible). Duels initiated with your Objective may not be canceled. Once per game, may take Rise, My Friend into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If this Effect canceled by opponent, stack it on Insignificant Rebellion.”.<ref name="cl-1262_11-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
